_comment: Hand decisions applied by the importer after extraction. Keyed by source_line
(1-based w:p index) plus a body fingerprint, so an edit upstream invalidates the
override loudly instead of silently applying to different text.
Never edit the .docx to record these — a re-export would lose them.

emphasis.reason: Italic applied to a lone semicolon — an authoring slip carrying no meaning. Confirmed by the user; it was the only emphasis anywhere in 21.2 (w:p 164-172), so the paragraph now has no italics at all.

emphasis.match_prefix: Board of General Superintendents that reflect
emphasis.reason: Italic on the inserted letter of 'reflects' — residue of an accepted tracked change. User: no italics at all in this paragraph.

emphasis.match_prefix: report to the subsequent General Assembly
emphasis.reason: Italic on the closing full stop — same tracked-change residue. User: no italics at all in this paragraph.

emphasis.match_prefix: business of the church board shall be
emphasis.reason: Bold on the trailing colon only. The other two bold spans in this paragraph are kept: 'Business.' is the run-in heading used throughout the section, and 'business of the church board' is deliberate emphasis.
Italic on the closing full stop. The book title 'Manual of the Church of the Nazarene' in the same paragraph is kept — it matches the other 62 italicised occurrences.
keeps: Manual of the Church of the Nazarene
